items.title: Jimmy and Jeannie Cheatham interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 12, 1998
items.q: The Queen came over and she had decided she loved country & western.

ctx.x: Yeah, on Sunday. So that extended our time. Because everybody else was getting killed. We had one short period in, I’ll say about 1954, when we were in Canada and we almost got clobbered in Canada. The Queen came over and she had decided she loved country & western. And for a short time, that’s all there was in Toronto, and every joint but ours was country & western people, even though they were from New York. But the Canadians didn’t know that. You know these guys come in there from New York because if you’ve…
And you’ve been with a couple of different record labels.
